This editorial illustration features a close-up portrait of a person's face, occupying most of the frame. The face is shown from the bridge of the nose to the chin, focusing on the eyes, cheeks, and mouth. The skin is weathered with fine lines, pores, and some freckles or spots. The eyes are dark, looking directly ahead, and the lips are pressed together in a subtle smile. Part of a dark-haired ear is visible on the right.

The background is a solid, light gray. Across the top, the word "TEMPO" is printed in large, bold, white, capital letters. Below this, in a smaller white font, is the text "EDISI 24-30 SEPTEMBER 2012". At the bottom right, the hashtag "#JOKOWINNER" is prominently displayed in white, followed by "DKI-1 2012-2017" underneath. A white box at the bottom left contains a barcode, numerical sequences like "00030" and "9 770126 427302", and the text "RP 29.700", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", and "ISSN: 0126-4273". A thin red vertical bar runs along the far left edge.
